summary: Frontend-only targeted retest of iteration_58 on mobile 390px. Created an ephemeral Firebase user with 8 TEST_Iter59 pratiche (6 tipi, tapparella 2026 and 2027, battente 2027, minimal), 2 verifiche and 1 Solo CE doc. Downloaded 45 PDFs via the UI: fascicolo plus CE for each pratica, full docs for tapparella27, sezionale and minimo, blank fascicolo plus CE for 6 tipi x 2 regimi, blank full docs for tapparella and sezionale 2027, and Solo CE. 0 console errors, 0 pageerrors. PASS (1): the note 'Le certificazioni e le dichiarazioni...' is now in C.3 on the last fascicolo page (heading y=344, note y=358, manuali table y=395) and no longer under A.3 on page 2. The fascicolo is now 4 pages (was 5) in every case: compilato, minimo, vuoto, both regimi, single and inside the full PDF. Page fills are 81/99/66/81% (minimo 81/99/70/81). The 'Pagina X di 4' numbering is consistent. There are no '(segue)' pages with only a few lines anywhere; C.4 and the signatures fit on page 4. The remaining '(segue)' pages in the full PDF (DM37, Verbale collaudo, Manuale) have 20+ lines each. Section 5 is intact on page 2, Allegato A is inline on page 2, and B/C start at the top of page 3/4. PASS (2): CE row 1 now reads '1. Chiusura — UNI EN 13241 / 13659' and ends at x=217, well before the Applicazione column (x=304). This holds in the pratica CE, the blank CE and the Solo CE. Visually confirmed, and the UI label wraps cleanly. PASS (3): no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: praticaPdf.js is still about 853 lines (over 700); consider splitting the fascicolo/allegati builders into their own module.
Page 2 of the fascicolo is filled to 99%, so any added A.3 row or longer A.1/A.2 content will overflow again. A keep-together on the A.3 table would be more robust.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Setup: python iter55_ui_setup.py setup, then python iter59_create.py (ids in /tmp/iter59_ids.json). Download the PDFs via UI to /tmp/iter59 (pratica-pdf-<k>, pratica-share-all, stampa-vuoto-*, documenti-tab-ce → documento-share; add an init script that sets navigator.share to undefined). Then run iter59_layout_check.py (near-empty '(segue)' pages, C.3 note position, CE row1 overlap) and iter58_fascicolo_layout_check.py (fills/sections; edit the glob to /tmp/iter59). Finish with iter55_ui_setup.py cleanup. Note: on the first pass, two blank downloads timed out because of test-side timing between rapid select changes; both passed on retry, and it is not an app bug.
